payload.explanation: The business UPDATE (session_c9cd09b4a799, pid 551) is blocked waiting on transactionid; pg_blocking_pids identifies session_5fa6eedf309c (pid 552) as the root blocker. That session is 'idle in transaction' after having run the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1, so it holds an uncommitted row lock on product_id=1. No other blocking chain links exist (other idle sessions ran only SELECT 1 and block nothing). Query stats show the UPDATE is fast (0.03ms) and the table has a primary key only, ruling out large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
